label: Profile
text: Arin Mallanna Tumbagi — Software Engineer at Saviynt, B.Tech Ocean Engineering at IIT Madras.

label: Profile
text: Arin builds identity infrastructure at Saviynt. Backends moving records at any scale, plus AI agents held to verified evidence. IIT Madras engineer, competitive programmer, ML-from-scratch habit.

label: Saviynt role
text: Software Engineer at Saviynt (identity governance) since Jun 2025: compliance engines, streaming exports, audit ingestion, agent safety.

label: SoD engine
text: Segregation-of-duties = proving no employee holds conflicting permissions (e.g. create AND approve a payment). Worst-case production run rebuilt from ~20h at 65 GB to minutes under 1 GB: one hierarchy pass plus bit-level permission comparison.

label: Export pipeline
text: s3-outputstream (v2.0.0, Maven Central, Apache-2.0): a Java OutputStream over S3 multipart with one reusable 5 MiB buffer and explicit commit/abort semantics — an upload publishes only on declared success. Streams formatted Excel inside ZIPs of any size.

label: License Intel
text: License Intelligence: an inference engine finding SAP license waste (dormant/over-privileged accounts), priced in dollars and removed via tasks. Validated 51/51 against live APIs; a test tenant showed seven findings worth about $11,000 a year (test result, not a production savings claim).

label: Agent safety
text: A safety engine for AI agents: effective-access analysis across 5 risk patterns (single over-privileged agent, agent-owner conflicts, delegation chains, credential-sharing groups, actions on a user's behalf), deterministic checks with cited evidence tracked to resolution.

label: Fraud agents
text: Bounded ReAct agents investigating emergency break-glass admin logs: one fraud hypothesis per run within strict step/time budgets, every cited event re-checked against source data, uncertain findings routed to humans. Public harness: 110 tests, 46/46 held-out synthetic variants.

label: Audit ingestion
text: Ordered, replayable audit ingestion for every privileged action: Kafka/Avro streams with duplicate-proof storage — publish first, mark after, merge rather than replace on refresh.

label: Nostos router
text: Nostos routes each LLM request to the server whose KV-cache already holds its conversation (radix-tree prefix affinity, weighed against queue and memory load). Passes responses through without buffering; stores fingerprints, never text. Live demo racing routing strategies.

label: Transformers x3
text: Same transformer 3x: PyTorch by hand with no model shortcuts, dependency-free C++17 (gpt2-cpp, five correctness tests), raw CUDA in progress from matmul against CPU reference toward FlashAttention-style benchmarks.

label: lm-train
text: lm-train: a 0.818M-param char-level GPT trained end to end on Shakespeare (val loss 1.75) with loss curves, checkpoint samples and a reproduce command.

label: Raft
text: raft-cpp: Raft consensus in dependency-free C++17 — leader election, log replication and a KV machine, chaos-tested across seeds over a simulated transport (no real networking; documented honestly).

label: Open source
text: 11 tools plus upstream pull requests across KiroCrew, OpenSearch, SGLang and lm-eval. Code at github.com/Arin016.

label: s3-outputstream
text: s3-outputstream: Java OutputStream over S3 multipart, one reusable 5 MiB buffer, commit-safe publishing, real-S3 conformance receipt. Apache-2.0, v2.0.0 on Maven Central.

label: gpt2-cpp
text: gpt2-cpp: GPT-2 in dependency-free C++17, tensor core to greedy decode in seven commits, five correctness tests. No frameworks, no BLAS.

label: context-lattice
text: context-lattice: source-verifiable hierarchical conversation memory for LLMs over MCP — every recalled fact links to its source file and a cryptographic fingerprint.

label: kyn
text: kyn: a control panel for long-running AI coding agents — named agents with persistent memory, scheduled tasks and human approval gates before consequential actions. Live demo online.

label: Y search
text: Y: private search over exported chat history, including timing questions ('what did we discuss last month?'). Fully offline, no data leaves the machine.

label: xx-cli
text: xx-cli: type a request in plain English, get the terminal command, shown for review before anything runs. Fully offline.

label: friday
text: friday: one searchable index of AI coding sessions across Claude Code, Kiro CLI and Codex. Read-only, one keystroke back to the original session.

label: bug-butcher
text: bug-butcher: a safety harness for delegating bug fixes to agents — plan agreed first, edits fenced to approved files, a failing-then-passing test required before a human merges.
